# 1. Fluad, Vaccine

## Compare DGE between organisms

```{r}
#Import ------
#t-Test
human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse")

#Limma
fluad_human_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired")

fluad_mouse_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         timepoint = str_remove(comparison_a, "Time"),
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired") 


#Merge datasets
degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human =
  bind_rows(
    human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    fluad_human_degs,
    fluad_mouse_degs
    )

#Summarize  
degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary = degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, test, paired) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_degs = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary

```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# Plot number of DEGs per test and significance level
degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary_plot_gg <- degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = timepoint,
    y = n_degs,
    fill = test,
    alpha = paired
  )) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, position = position_dodge2()) +
  
  # Manual colors per test
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "t-Test" = "gray25",
    "Limma" = "#4DBBD5FF"
  )) +
  
  # Alpha: paired = 1, unpaired = 0.5
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Paired" = 1, "Unpaired" = 0.2)) +
  
  # Continuous x-axis for numeric timepoints
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = sort(unique(degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary$timepoint)),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(
    title = "Total DEGs by test and timepoint",
    subtitle = "Comparison across tests (FDR ≤ 0.05), Fluad vaccine",
    x = "Day",
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    fill = "Test",
    alpha = "Pairing"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~organism, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray75", linetype = 3),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "gray75")
  )

# Render plot
degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary_plot_gg

degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary_plot_gg %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "influenza_fluad_mouse_human_dge_ttest_limma_summary.png"),
         width = 5,
         height = 5)
```



## Get best and worst predicted genes

Which genes have the least zscore?

### Get by zscore

Get highly correlated genes and discretize by quantile

#### Mouse

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Get highly correlated genes and discretize by quantile -----
#By zscores ------
#Mouse
zscore_genes_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  select(human_symbol,timepoint,  mean_human, mean_mouse, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_human, z_score_h2m) %>% 
  arrange(z_score_h2m, human_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
                    arrange(abs(z_score_h2m)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_mouse,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_mouse = round(mean_mouse, 3),
         comparison = "Human vs Mouse") %>% 
  rename(zscore = z_score_h2m,
         mean_model = mean_mouse,
         pval_model_adj = pval_adj_mouse) %>% 
  
  #Discretize by quantile (zscore)
  mutate(
    quartile_label = cut(abs(zscore),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(zscore),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")),
    timepoint_day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(pval_model_adj = if_else(pval_model_adj <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG"),
         pval_human_adj = if_else(pval_adj_human <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG")) 

#Pivot and sum only DEGs
zscore_genes_mouse %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj),
               names_to =  "model",
               values_to = "deg") %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, model, deg) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  filter(deg =="DEG")
```

####FIT

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#FIT
zscore_genes_fit = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  select(human_symbol,timepoint,  mean_human, mean_fit, pval_adj_fit, pval_adj_human, z_score_h2fit) %>% 
  arrange(z_score_h2fit, human_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  arrange(abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_fit,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_fit = round(mean_fit, 3),
         comparison = "Human vs FIT") %>% 
  rename(zscore = z_score_h2fit,
         mean_model = mean_fit,
         pval_model_adj = pval_adj_fit) %>%
  
  #Discretize by quantile (zscore)
  mutate(quartile_label = cut(abs(zscore),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(zscore),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")),
    timepoint_day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
    mutate(pval_model_adj = if_else(pval_model_adj <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG"),
         pval_human_adj = if_else(pval_adj_human <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG")) 

#Bind tables
zscore_genes = bind_rows(zscore_genes_fit, zscore_genes_mouse)

#Print
zscore_genes
```

Summarize genes by quantile

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Summarize genes by quantile ------
degs_pos_neg_summary_quantiles_best_worst_data <- zscore_genes %>%
  filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
         pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>% 
  mutate(
    quartiles_grouped = case_when(
      quartile_label %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<=Q25",
      quartile_label %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">=Q75",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  drop_na(quartiles_grouped) %>% 
  group_by(comparison, timepoint, quartiles_grouped) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparison == "Human vs FIT" ~ paste("FIT", quartiles_grouped),
                               comparison == "Human vs Mouse" ~ paste("Mouse", quartiles_grouped),
                               T~comparison)) %>% 
  ungroup() 

#Print
degs_pos_neg_summary_quantiles_best_worst_data
```

### Scatterplot of correlation

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
#Scatterplot of correlation --------
#Get all genes by quantile
quantiles <- zscore_genes %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    q10  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Cumulative quantiles
diff_correlation_plot_data <- zscore_genes %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(quantiles, by = "comparison") %>%
  mutate(
    Q10  = abs(zscore) <= q10,
    Q25  = abs(zscore) <= q25,
    Q50  = abs(zscore) <= q50,
    Q75  = abs(zscore) <= q75,
    Q100 = abs(zscore) <= q100
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Q10, Q25, Q50, Q75, Q100),
    names_to = "quantile_label_grouped",
    values_to = "in_quantile"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    quantile_label_grouped = fct_relevel(quantile_label_grouped, "Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")
  ) %>%
  filter(in_quantile) %>%
  select(-in_quantile)

#Print
diff_correlation_plot_data

#Diagnostics
diff_correlation_plot_data %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj, comparison) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj),
               names_to =  "model",
               values_to = "deg") %>% 
  group_by(comparison, model, timepoint, deg) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  filter(deg =="DEG")
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
abs_diff_correlation_plot_data_split_plot_mouse = diff_correlation_plot_data %>%

    x = mean_model,
    y = mean_human

             aes(color = quartile_label,

             fill = "#4DBBD5FF",
             alpha = 1,
             size = 1,
             pch = 21,
             data = zscore_genes %>%
               filter(comparison == "Human vs Mouse") %>%
               filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
                      pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>%
               filter(quartile_label %in% c("Q50", "Q75", "Q100"))) +

  geom_point(color = "#4361ee",
             fill = "#4361ee",
             alpha = 1,
             size = 1, 
             pch = 21,
             data = zscore_genes %>%
               filter(human_symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes)) %>% 
               filter(comparison == "Human vs Mouse") %>%
               filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
                      pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>%
               filter(quartile_label %in% c("Q50", "Q75", "Q100"))) +
  #Same DEGs (BEST)
  geom_point(color = "black",
             fill = "#4DBBD5FF",
             alpha = 1,
             size = 2,
             pch = 21,
             data = zscore_genes %>%
               filter(comparison == "Human vs Mouse") %>%
               filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
                      pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>%
               filter(quartile_label %in% c(
                 "Q10",
                 "Q25"
                 ))) +
  
  #Same DEGs (Best, Immune)
  geom_point(color = "black",
             fill = "#4361ee",
             alpha = 1,
             size = 2,
             pch = 21,
             data = zscore_genes %>%
               filter(human_symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes)) %>% 
               filter(comparison == "Human vs Mouse") %>%
               filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
                      pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>%
               filter(quartile_label %in% c(
                 "Q10",
                 "Q25"
                 ))) +
   #Guide lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Q10" = "black",
                               "Q25" = "gray25",
                               "Q50" = "gray50",
                               "Q75" = "gray75",
                               "Q100" = "gray90")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Q10" = "black",
                               "Q25" = "gray25",
                               "Q50" = "gray50",
                               "Q75" = "gray75",
                               "Q100" = "gray90")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-4, 4)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 4)) +
  
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.key.width = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, vjust = 0.9),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7, vjust = 0.5, hjust = -0.2)) +
  labs(x = "Mouse L2FC",
       y = "Human L2FC",
       alpha = "Quantiles",
       fill = "Quantiles",
```

### Lineplot of gene expression by quantile

```{r}
# Lineplot of selected genes -----
#Selected genes by quantile and model
selected_genes_lines_fit = diff_correlation_plot_data %>% 
  filter(quartile_label == c("Q10") & comparison == "Human vs FIT", 
         pval_model_adj == "DEG" | pval_human_adj == "DEG") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, comparison, quartile_label, zscore) %>% 
  mutate(quartile_label = "<=Q10") %>% 
    distinct()

selected_genes_lines_mouse = diff_correlation_plot_data %>% 
  filter(quartile_label == c("Q10") & comparison == "Human vs Mouse", 
         pval_model_adj == "DEG" | pval_human_adj == "DEG") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, comparison, quartile_label, zscore) %>% 
  mutate(quartile_label = "<=Q10") %>% 
    distinct()

#Bind tables
selected_genes_lines_models = bind_rows(selected_genes_lines_mouse, selected_genes_lines_fit) 

#Get l2fc 
selected_genes_lines = diff_correlation_plot_data %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_human, mean_model, comparison) %>% 
  inner_join(selected_genes_lines_models %>% 
               select(human_symbol, comparison),
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "comparison")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  bind_rows(selected_genes_lines_models %>% 
              select(human_symbol,comparison) %>% 
              mutate(timepoint = 0,
                     mean_human = 0,
                     mean_model = 0)) %>% 
  arrange(human_symbol)  %>% 
  distinct()

#All genes
selected_genes_lines_all = diff_correlation_plot_data %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_human, mean_model,comparison) %>% 
  distinct()

#Add day 0
df_selected_genes_lines_plot = selected_genes_lines_all %>% 
  bind_rows(selected_genes_lines_all %>% 
              mutate(timepoint = 0,
                     mean_human = 0,
                     mean_model = 0)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(human_symbol)


#Filter top 5 genes
top5_genes = selected_genes_lines_models %>% 
  # filter(human_symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes)) %>% 
  group_by(comparison) %>% 
  slice_min(abs(zscore), n = 5) %>% 
  select(human_symbol, comparison, zscore) %>% 
  inner_join(selected_genes_lines, by = join_by("human_symbol", "comparison")) %>% 
  mutate(group = case_when(str_detect(comparison, "FIT") ~ "FIT",
                                       str_detect(comparison, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse"))
#Get labels for the top 5 genes
top5_genes_labels = top5_genes %>% 
  filter(timepoint > 0) %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, comparison) %>% 
  slice_max(mean_human, n = 1)

```

Plot all genes and all selected genes by quantile

```{r}
#Plot all genes and all selected genes by quantile -----
df_selected_genes_lines_plot_plot = df_selected_genes_lines_plot %>% 
  mutate(group = "All") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint,
      y = mean_mouse,
      group = human_symbol) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.5, linetype = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~fct_rev(comparison), nrow = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  
  #All human genes
  geom_point(color = "gray80",
             alpha = 0.1,
             mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                           y = mean_human)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray80",
            alpha = 0.1,
             mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                           y = mean_human)) +
  
  #All model genes
  geom_point(color = "gray80",
             alpha = 0.1,
             mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                           y = mean_model)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray80",
            alpha = 0.1,
             mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                           y = mean_model)) +
  
  #All human selected genes
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2,
             mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                           y = mean_human,
                           color = group),
             data = selected_genes_lines %>% 
               mutate(group = "Human")) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2,
             mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                           y = mean_human,
                           color = group),
            data = selected_genes_lines %>% 
              mutate(group = "Human"))  +
  
  #All selected genes by model
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2,
             mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                           y = mean_model,
                           color = group),
             data = selected_genes_lines %>% 
              mutate(group = case_when(str_detect(comparison, "FIT") ~ "Model",
                                       str_detect(comparison, "Mouse") ~ "Model"))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2,
             mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                           y = mean_model,
                           color = group),
            data = selected_genes_lines %>% 
              mutate(group = case_when(str_detect(comparison, "FIT") ~ "Model",
                                       str_detect(comparison, "Mouse") ~ "Model")))  +
  
  
  #All selected Immune genes by model
  geom_point(alpha = 1,
             mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                           y = mean_model,
                           color = group),
             data = selected_genes_lines %>% 
               filter(human_symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes)) %>%
              mutate(group = case_when(str_detect(comparison, "FIT") ~ "Immune",
                                       str_detect(comparison, "Mouse") ~ "Immune"))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 1,
             mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                           y = mean_model,
                           color = group),
            data = selected_genes_lines %>% 
              filter(human_symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes)) %>%
              mutate(group = case_when(str_detect(comparison, "FIT") ~ "Immune",
                                       str_detect(comparison, "Mouse") ~ "Immune")))  +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1, 3, 7, 10),
                     expand = c(0.05, 0.05)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 2)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Model" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Model" = "#4DBBD5FF",
```

##Functional analysis

### Condition-wise

BTMs correlation, intra- and inter-species

#### Immune

##### Mean Log2FC and GSEA (Immune)

Compare means and NES Import

```{r}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Influenza", vaccine = "Fluad",
         timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
  rename(mean_l2fc = mean,
         ci_lower = lower,
         ci_upper = upper)

#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "influenza_fluad_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_btm_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol") %>% 
  filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) 

dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_process_genes.rds")))

dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen,
            group, subgroup) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

pvals_vs_zero <- dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  group_by(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>% 
  rstatix::t_test(mean_l2fc ~ 1, mu = 0) %>%    
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%  
  add_significance()

dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  dplyr::count(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n < 2)

dge_btm_mean_process <- dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  left_join(
    pvals_vs_zero %>% 
      select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process, p, p_adjust = p.adj),
    by = c("organism", "pathogen", "timepoint", "process")
  ) %>% 
  clean_names()

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))

```



##### GSEA

```{r message=FALSE}
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint),
          log2fold_change_logp = log2fold_change * -log(adj_p_val)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, rank = log2fold_change_logp)

#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_btm_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "BTMs")


gsea_btm_results = gsea_btm_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  full_join(dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
              rename(p_adjust_mean = p_adjust), by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_btm_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
```

###### Summarize inter-individual correlation

1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
btm_samples_long = dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
btm_samples_annotation = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

#Print
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary

correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
  labs(title = "Correlation between organisms,\nBTMs, Means",
```

###### Summarize inter-individual correlation

1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
hallmarks_samples_long = dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
hallmarks_samples_annotation = hallmarks_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
hallmarks_samples_wide_all = hallmarks_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all = hallmarks_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_r = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_p = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(hallmarks_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(hallmarks_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary

correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_hallmarks_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

# 2. Engerix B, Vaccine

### Condition-wise

BTMs correlation, intra- and inter-species

#### BTMs

##### Mean Log2FC

Compare means and NES Import

```{r}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Hepatitis B", vaccine = "EngerixB",
         timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint))

#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_btm_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol") %>% 
  filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) 

dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_process_genes.rds")))

dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen,
            group, subgroup) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

pvals_vs_zero <- dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  group_by(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>% 
  rstatix::t_test(mean_l2fc ~ 1, mu = 0) %>%     # testa média contra zero
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%      # corrige FDR
  add_significance()

dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  dplyr::count(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n < 2)

dge_btm_mean_process <- dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  left_join(
    pvals_vs_zero %>% 
      select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process, p, p_adjust = p.adj),
    by = c("organism", "pathogen", "timepoint", "process")
  )  
  

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
```

##### GSEA

```{r}
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint),
          log2fold_change_logp = log2fold_change * -log(adj_p_val)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, rank = log2fold_change_logp)

#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_btm_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "BTMs")


gsea_btm_results = gsea_btm_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  full_join(dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
              rename(p_adjust_mean = p_adjust), by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_btm_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  full_join(dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
              rename(p_adjust_mean = p_adjust), by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_hallmarks_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_hallmarks_results.rds")))
```

###### Summarize inter-individual correlation

1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
btm_samples_long = dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
btm_samples_annotation = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

Plot scatterplot

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint,
      y = mean,
      group = comparison,
      color = comparison,
      fill = comparison) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +

                  ymax = ci_high), width = 0.2,
```

# 3. S. aureus

## Functional analysis

### Immune

BTMs correlation, intra- and inter-species

#### Mean Log2FC

Compare means and NES Import

```{r}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Saureus")
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "saureus_infection_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct()

#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_btm_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol") %>% 
  filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) 

dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_process_genes.rds")))

dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc), 
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen,
            group, subgroup) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

pvals_vs_zero <- dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  group_by(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>% 
  rstatix::t_test(mean_l2fc ~ 1, mu = 0) %>%     # testa média contra zero
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%      # corrige FDR
  add_significance()

dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  dplyr::count(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n < 2)

dge_btm_mean_process <- dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  left_join(
    pvals_vs_zero %>% 
      select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process, p, p_adjust = p.adj),
    by = c("organism", "pathogen", "timepoint", "process")
  )  

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
```

#### GSEA

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint),
          log2fold_change_logp = log2fold_change * -log(adj_p_val)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, rank = log2fold_change_logp)


#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_btm_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "BTM")


gsea_btm_results = gsea_btm_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
              rename(p_adjust_mean = p_adjust), by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_btm_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
```

##### Summarize inter-individual correlation

1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
# Prepare long-format table of mean log2FC per sample and process
btm_samples_long = dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
btm_samples_annotation = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_condition1 = if_else(comparison == "Human vs. Human", "24", timepoint_condition1),
         timepoint_condition2 = if_else(comparison == "Human vs. Human", "24", timepoint_condition2),
         timepoint = if_else(comparison == "Human vs. Human", 24, timepoint))  %>% 
  distinct()

# Save output
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))


```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    cor_label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2), ", R² = ", round(r_squared, 2))
  ) %>%
```

##### Summarize inter-individual correlation

1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
# Prepare long-format table of mean log2FC per sample and process
hallmarks_samples_long = dge_hallmarks_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
hallmarks_samples_annotation = hallmarks_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
hallmarks_samples_wide_all = hallmarks_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all = hallmarks_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_r = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_p = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(hallmarks_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(hallmarks_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

   # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_condition1 = if_else(comparison == "Human vs. Human", 24, timepoint_condition1),
         timepoint_condition2 = if_else(comparison == "Human vs. Human", 24, timepoint_condition2),
         timepoint = if_else(comparison == "Human vs. Human", 24, timepoint))  %>% 
  distinct()

# Save output

correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_hallmarks_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))


```

# 4. E. coli

## Functional analysis

### Condition-wise analysis

#### Immune

BTMs correlation, intra- and inter-species Compare means and NES

```{r}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Ecoli")
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "ecoli_infection_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_btm_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol") %>% 
  filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) 

dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_process_genes.rds")))

dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen,
            group, subgroup) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

pvals_vs_zero <- dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  group_by(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>% 
  rstatix::t_test(mean_l2fc ~ 1, mu = 0) %>%     # testa média contra zero
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%      # corrige FDR
  add_significance()

dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  dplyr::count(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n < 2)

dge_btm_mean_process <- dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  left_join(
    pvals_vs_zero %>% 
      select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process, p, p_adjust = p.adj),
    by = c("organism", "pathogen", "timepoint", "process")
  )  

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
```

##### GSEA

```{r}
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint),
          log2fold_change_logp = log2fold_change * -log(adj_p_val)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, rank = log2fold_change_logp)

#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_btm_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "BTM")


gsea_btm_results = gsea_btm_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
              rename(p_adjust_mean = p_adjust), by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_btm_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
```

###### summarise inter-individual correlation

 1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
# Prepare long-format table of mean log2FC per sample and process
hallmarks_samples_long = dge_hallmarks_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  select(organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) 

# Annotation table
hallmarks_samples_annotation = hallmarks_samples_long %>% 
  select(organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
hallmarks_samples_wide_all = hallmarks_samples_long %>% 
  select(-timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all = hallmarks_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "spearman")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_r = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_p = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_hallmarks_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(hallmarks_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(hallmarks_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 

  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2)) %>% 

  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric())

# Save output

correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_hallmarks_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
#Import datasets
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
#Get total genes by each condition
degs_mouse = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Mouse")
degs_human = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Human")

degs_mouse_summarize = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  group_by(organism, pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n()) 

#Print
degs_mouse_summarize

#Get overlap -----
#Get symbols
degs_mouse_genes = degs_mouse %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint_comparison, pathogen) %>% 
  distinct()

degs_human_genes = degs_human %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint_comparison, pathogen) %>% 
  distinct()

#Inner join, Mouse and Human ------

#Mouse
degs_human_and_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  inner_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("pathogen", "human_symbol", "timepoint_comparison")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse AND Human",
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         organism = "Mouse",
         group = "Common")

#Duplicate rows for human
degs_human_and_mouse_genes_human = degs_human_and_mouse_genes %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")


#Anti join, Human vs Mouse -------
#Human
#Human vs Mouse
degs_human_Not_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("pathogen", "human_symbol", "timepoint_comparison")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Human NOT Mouse", 
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         organism = "Human",
         group = "Not common")

#Models
#Mouse vs Human
degs_mouse_Not_human_genes = degs_mouse_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_human_genes, 
             by = join_by("pathogen", "human_symbol", "timepoint_comparison")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse NOT Human",
         organism = "Mouse",
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         group = "Not common")


#Merge data ------
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes = 
  bind_rows(degs_human_and_mouse_genes,
            degs_human_and_mouse_genes_human,
            degs_human_Not_mouse_genes,
            degs_mouse_Not_human_genes 
            )

#Classify by same and exclusive DEGs -----
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary = degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, condition, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            organism,
            comparison,
            group) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  separate(timepoint_comparison, into = c("timepoint_mouse", "timepoint_human"), sep = "-", remove = F) %>% 
  filter(!c(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" & timepoint_mouse == "24h"))
  

ranges_y = degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  summarise(limit_max = max(n))
```

### Correlation: Genes, means

```{r}

#Log2FC from samples

#Metadata from samples
# all_human_mouse_metadata =

#DEGs (matched)

  readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs_matched.rds"))

#Functional modules

all_degs_human_mouse %>%

  distinct()
```


```{r}
#Pivot wider
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, human_symbol, timepoint_comparison, mean_log2fc, p_adj = adj_p_val, tstatistic = t) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c("organism"),
              values_from = c(mean_log2fc, p_adj, tstatistic),
              names_sep = "_") %>% 
  clean_names() 

  
# Calculate the correlation
#Get immune and non immune genes
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune = 
  
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  mutate(gene_type = "All genes") %>% 
  
  bind_rows(
  #Same DEGs
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05) %>% 
  mutate(gene_type = "DEGs"), 
  #Classify as immune or non_immune 
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
  mutate(gene_type = if_else(human_symbol %in% c(btm_annotation_genes %>%
                               filter(module_category == "immune") %>% 
                               pull(symbol)),
                             "Immune",
                             "Not-immune")) %>% 
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05))
```

### Correlation: RRHO of means

```{r}
# 1. Identify all unique pathogen and timepoint combinations
combinations <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  distinct(pathogen, timepoint_comparison)

# 2. Initialize a list to store results from each iteration
all_rrho_results <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(combinations)) {
  
  curr_pathogen <- combinations$pathogen[i]
  curr_timepoint <- combinations$timepoint_comparison[i]
  
  # A. Filter and Prepare Differential Expression (DDE) Scores
  rrho_input_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
    filter(pathogen == curr_pathogen, timepoint_comparison == curr_timepoint) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_adj_human), !is.na(p_adj_mouse), 
           !is.na(mean_log2fc_human), !is.na(mean_log2fc_mouse)) %>%
    mutate(
      # Handle p-values of 0 to avoid infinite logs
      p_adj_human = ifelse(p_adj_human == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_adj_human),
      p_adj_mouse = ifelse(p_adj_mouse == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_adj_mouse),
      # Calculate DDE score: -log10(p-value) * sign of Fold Change
      score_human = -log10(p_adj_human) * sign(mean_log2fc_human),
      score_mouse = -log10(p_adj_mouse) * sign(mean_log2fc_mouse)
    )

  # Skip if the gene list is too small (RRHO2 requires a minimum set)
  if(nrow(rrho_input_data) < 100) next 

  # B. Prepare Sorted Gene Lists for RRHO2
  # Sorting from highest to lowest DDE score is mandatory for RRHO analysis
  gene_list1 <- rrho_input_data %>% 
    arrange(desc(score_human)) %>%
    select(Genes = human_symbol, DDE = score_human) %>% 
    as.data.frame()
    
  gene_list2 <- rrho_input_data %>% 
    arrange(desc(score_mouse)) %>%
    select(Genes = human_symbol, DDE = score_mouse) %>% 
    as.data.frame()

  # Identify the Biological Split Point (where DDE score crosses zero)
  # This marks the boundary between Up-regulated and Down-regulated genes
  split_h_val <- sum(gene_list1$DDE > 0)
  split_m_val <- sum(gene_list2$DDE > 0)

  # C. Execute RRHO2
  # Using 'try' to skip iterations that might encounter mathematical errors
  rrho_obj <- try(RRHO2_initialize(gene_list2, gene_list1, 
                                   labels = c("Mouse", "Human"), 
                                   boundary = 0.01,
                                   log10.ind = TRUE, 
                                   method = "hyper"), silent = TRUE)
  
  if(inherits(rrho_obj, "try-error")) next

  # Transform the hypermat (matrix) into a long format dataframe for ggplot2
  temp_df <- as.data.frame(rrho_obj$hypermat) %>%
    mutate(Mouse_Rank = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Mouse_Rank, names_to = "Human_Rank", values_to = "LogP") %>%
    mutate(
      Human_Rank = as.numeric(gsub("V", "", Human_Rank)),
      pathogen = curr_pathogen,       
      timepoint = curr_timepoint,
      # Store the split points to draw exact quadrant boundaries later
      split_h = split_h_val,
      split_m = split_m_val
    )

  all_rrho_results[[i]] <- temp_df
}

# Combine all results into a single final dataframe
final_rrho_df <- bind_rows(all_rrho_results)

# Save the processed data for visualization
final_rrho_df %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_rrho_df.rds"))
 

```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggh4x)

final_rrho_df_plot <- final_rrho_df %>%
  mutate(pathogen = as.character(pathogen),
    pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma")) %>%
    #Reorder timepoints
  separate(timepoint, into = c("timepoint_mouse", "timepoint_human"), remove = F) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_mouse = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7"))) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint_mouse) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = fct_inorder(timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    LogP_Final = ifelse(LogP > 50, 50, LogP)
  )
    

# --- Step 2: Generate the Visualization ---
rrho_plot <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = final_rrho_df_plot, 
              aes(x = Human_Rank, y = Mouse_Rank, fill = LogP_Final),
              interpolate = T) +
  
  # C. Faceting: Using ggh4x for nested labels
  facet_nested_wrap(~pathogen + timepoint,
                    scales = "free", 
                    nrow = 4) +
  
  # D. Scale Adjustments
  scale_x_reverse(expand = c(0,0)) + 
  scale_y_reverse(expand = c(0,0)) +
  
  # E. Color Mapping
  # scale_fill_gradientn(
  #   colors = c("white", "#4361ee", "#a480cf", "#46eec6"),
  #   values = c(0, 0.1, 0.5, 1), 
  #   na.value = "white", 
  #   name =  "-log10(p-value)"
  # ) +
  
scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("white", "#4361ee", "#a480cf", "#46eec6"),
    # O valor 0.02 (2% de 50 = 1) garante que o azul apareça já no LogP = 1.
    # O valor 0.2 (20% de 50 = 10) mantém tons intermediários visíveis.
    values = c(0, 0.02, 0.2, 1), 
    limits = c(0, 50),
    name = "-log10(p-value)",
    # Definindo quebras em 0, 25 e 50 para clareza visual
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50),
    labels = c("0", "25", "≥50")
  ) +
  # F. Labels and Styling
  labs(
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
# Prepare data
rank_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_log2fc_human) | !is.na(mean_log2fc_mouse),
         !is.na(p_adj_human), !is.na(p_adj_mouse)) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>%
  mutate(
    score_human = -log10(p_adj_human) * sign(mean_log2fc_human),
    score_mouse = -log10(p_adj_mouse) * sign(mean_log2fc_mouse),
    Human_Rank_Val = rank(score_human),
    Mouse_Rank_Val = rank(score_mouse),
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = as.character(pathogen),
    pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma"))

# Calcular os limites por grupo
thresholds <- rank_data %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    # Encontra o maior rank entre os genes com log2fc negativo
    v_line = max(Human_Rank_Val[mean_log2fc_human < 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    h_line = max(Mouse_Rank_Val[mean_log2fc_mouse < 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Plotar como Heatmap de Densidade (Raster)

 stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(density / sum(density))),

             linetype = "solid", color = "white", alpha = 1, linewidth = 2) +
  geom_hline(data = thresholds, aes(yintercept = h_line),
```

```{r}
compute_corr_by_pathogen = function(df) {

  genes_samples_wide =
    df %>% 
    select(human_symbol, condition, log2fc) %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = condition,
      values_from = log2fc
    ) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("human_symbol")

  cor_mat = rcorr(as.matrix(genes_samples_wide), type = "spearman")

  tibble(
    condition1 = rep(colnames(cor_mat$r), each = ncol(cor_mat$r)),
    condition2 = rep(colnames(cor_mat$r), times = ncol(cor_mat$r)),
    correlation = as.vector(cor_mat$r),
    p_value     = as.vector(cor_mat$P),
    n_genes     = as.vector(cor_mat$n)
  )
}

#Compute correlation
correlation_long_by_pathogen =
  genes_samples_long %>% 
  group_by(pathogen) %>% 
  group_modify(~ compute_corr_by_pathogen(.x)) %>% 
  ungroup()


#Clean 
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary =
  correlation_long_by_pathogen %>% 

  inner_join(
    samples_annotation %>% 
      rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
      rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
    by = "condition1"
  ) %>% 

  inner_join(
    samples_annotation %>% 
      rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
      rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
    by = "condition2"
  ) %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  filter(pathogen == pathogen_condition1,
         pathogen == pathogen_condition2) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(
    comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
    timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2)
  ) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics
  group_by(pathogen, comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    timepoint_condition1,
    timepoint_condition2,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 

  arrange(pathogen, comparison)  %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(pathogen, comparison, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  # For same-organism comparisons, keep only matching timepoints
  filter(!(comparison == "Mouse vs. Mouse" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2),
         !(comparison == "Human vs. Human" & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2))




correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  # Numeric representation of timepoint for plotting
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition2 %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  filter(!(pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B") & timepoint_condition1 != timepoint_condition2))

correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary
```

```{r}
#Convert to wide
dge_btm_process_genes_wide =
  dge_btm_process_genes_matched  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    select(symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, pathogen, organism, timepoint, process, group) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = organism,
      values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)
    ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order))) %>% 
    distinct() %>%
    select(
      symbol,
      pathogen,
      process, 
      timepoint,
      Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse,
      Human = mean_l2fc_Human,
      adj_p_val_Mouse,
      adj_p_val_Human,
      group
    ) %>% 
  drop_na(Human, Mouse) 

safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y),
  otherwise = NULL
)

dge_btm_process_genes_correlation = dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(
      x = Human, y = Mouse, method = "pearson"
    )),
    .groups = "drop",
    n_genes = n(),
    group
  ) %>%
  # substituir NULL por lista com NA
  mutate(test_result = purrr::map(
    test_result,
    ~ if (is.null(.x))
      list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)
    else
      .x 
    )) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$estimate),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=",
      round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=",
      round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ",
      p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
          timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus"), 
                                 paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                                 paste0("Day ", timepoint)),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, parse_number(timepoint)),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"))

filter_1 = dge_btm_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(process, 
          -abs(cor_value)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-cor_label,  -p_value)

filter_1 %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint)  %>% 
  arrange() %>% 
  summarise(mean_cor = mean(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            median_cor = median(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            mean_rsq = mean(r_squared, na.rm = T))
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----

safe_cor_test <- function(x, y, method) {
  # Remove NAs and infinite values first
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  
  # cor.test requires n >= 3 to run without error
  if (length(x) < 3 || sd(x) == 0 || sd(y) == 0) {
    return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  } else {
    tryCatch({
      ct <- cor.test(x, y, method = method)
      return(list(estimate = unname(ct$estimate), p.value = ct$p.value))
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
    })
  }
}


# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method =  "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    filter = "all",
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      p_label
    )
  )

cor_labels_filter_Mouse <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_mean_Mouse <= 0.25) %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_mouse = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value_mouse   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    r_squared_mouse = cor_value_mouse^2,
    p_label_mouse = case_when(
      p_value_mouse <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse, 2),
      p_label_mouse
    )
  )

cor_labels_filter_Mouse_Human <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_mean_Mouse <= 0.25, p_adjust_mean_Human <= 0.25) %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_mouse_human = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value_mouse_human   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    r_squared_mouse_human = cor_value_mouse_human^2,
    p_label_mouse_human = case_when(
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse_human = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse_human, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse_human, 2),
      p_label_mouse_human
    )
  )


# NES vs NES
# Means vs means
cor_labels_nes <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = nes_Mouse,
         Human = nes_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method =  "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    filter = "all",
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      p_label
    )
  )

dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_df = dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order)),
         process = str_wrap(process, width = 15)) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_filter_Mouse, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_filter_Mouse_Human, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(cor_labels_all_filtered = paste0("All: ", cor_label, ",\nM: ", cor_label_mouse, ",\nM&H: ", cor_label_mouse_human)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
          timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus"), 
                                 paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                                 paste0("Day ", timepoint)),
         facet_name = paste0(timepoint, "\n", cor_labels_all_filtered),
         facet_name = fct_reorder(facet_name, parse_number(timepoint)),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Saureus" ~ "Staphylococcus aureus",
                              pathogen == "Ecoli" ~ "Escherichia coli",
                              T ~pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"))

# 1. Preparar o "Dummy Data" para forçar os limites
# Vamos encontrar o maior valor absoluto entre X e Y para cada painel
dummy_limits <- dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_df %>%
  group_by(pathogen, facet_name) %>% # Agrupe pelas mesmas variáveis do seu facet
  summarise(
    max_val = max(abs(c(mean_log2fc_Mouse, mean_log2fc_Human)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # Adiciona um "respiro" (ex: 10%) para o ponto não ficar cortado na borda
  mutate(max_val = max_val * 1.1) %>% 
  ungroup
```

```{r fig.height=9, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Plot correlation plot (means)
dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_plot =

  labs(fill = "Group",
```

```{r fig.height=16, fig.width=16}
#Convert to wide
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched  %>%

  select(pathogen, symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, organism, timepoint, process, group) %>%
```
