```{r fig.height=16, fig.width=16}
  group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
              values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%  
  #Remove duplicates
  select(-process) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
          timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus"), 
                                 paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                                 paste0("Day ", timepoint)),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, parse_number(timepoint)),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"))

#Convert to wide
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide =
  dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    select(symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, pathogen, organism, timepoint, process, group) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = organism,
      values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)
    ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order))) %>% 
    distinct() %>%
    select(
      symbol,
      pathogen,
      process, 
      timepoint,
      Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse,
      Human = mean_l2fc_Human,
      adj_p_val_Mouse,
      adj_p_val_Human,
      group
    ) %>% 
  drop_na(Human, Mouse) 

safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y),
  otherwise = NULL
)

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation_pearson = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(
      x = Human, y = Mouse, method = "pearson"
    )),
    .groups = "drop",
    n_genes = n(),
    group
  ) %>%
  # substituir NULL por lista com NA
  mutate(test_result = purrr::map(
    test_result,
    ~ if (is.null(.x))
      list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)
    else
      .x 
    )) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$estimate),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=",
      round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=",
      round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ",
      p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
          timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus"), 
                                 paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                                 paste0("Day ", timepoint)),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, parse_number(timepoint)),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"))

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation_spearman = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(
      x = Human, y = Mouse, method = "spearman"
    )),
    .groups = "drop",
    n_genes = n(),
    group
  ) %>%
  # substituir NULL por lista com NA
  mutate(test_result = purrr::map(
    test_result,
    ~ if (is.null(.x))
      list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)
    else
      .x 
    )) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_spearman = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$estimate),
    p_value_spearman   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(
    r_squared_spearman = cor_value_spearman^2,
    p_label_spearman = case_when(
      p_value_spearman <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_spearman <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_spearman <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_spearman = paste0(
      "r=",
      round(cor_value_spearman, 2),
      ", R²=",
      round(r_squared_spearman, 2),
      ", ",
      p_label_spearman
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
          timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus"), 
                                 paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                                 paste0("Day ", timepoint)),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, parse_number(timepoint)),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"))



dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation_pearson %>% 
  inner_join(dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation_spearman %>% 
               select(pathogen, timepoint, process, cor_label_spearman),
             by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint, process)) 



filter_1 = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(process, 
          -abs(cor_value)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-cor_label,  -p_value)

filter_1 %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint)  %>% 
  arrange() %>% 
  summarise(mean_cor = mean(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            mean_rsq = mean(r_squared, na.rm = T))
```

Are the leading edges in mice the same in humans?

```{r}
gsea_hallmarks_results_core = gsea_hallmarks_results_all_matched %>% 
  separate_rows(core_enrichment, sep = "/")

gsea_hallmarks_results_core_joined =
  gsea_hallmarks_results_core %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
         gene = core_enrichment,
         set_size_human = set_size) %>% 
  mutate(human_core = TRUE) %>% 
  full_join(
    gsea_hallmarks_results_core %>% 
      filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
      select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
             gene = core_enrichment,
             set_size_mouse = set_size) %>% 
      mutate(mouse_core = TRUE),
    by = c("pathogen", "process", "timepoint", "gene")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      human_core == TRUE & mouse_core == TRUE ~ "Shared",
      human_core == TRUE & is.na(mouse_core) ~ "Human only",
      mouse_core == TRUE & is.na(human_core) ~ "Mouse only",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(pathogen, timepoint, process, status)


shared_perc = gsea_hallmarks_results_core_joined %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process, status) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>% 
  mutate(percent = (n / sum(n)) * 100,
         percent = percent %>% round(0)) %>% 
  ungroup() 

#Which are the processes that share most of the core genes?
shared_perc %>% 
  filter(status == "Shared") %>% 
  arrange(-n, -percent)

#What is the mean percentage?
mean_percentage_shared = shared_perc %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, status) %>% 
  summarise(mean_perc = mean(percent)) %>% 
  filter(status == "Shared")

mean_percentage_shared


shared_perc_df_plot = shared_perc %>% 
  inner_join(gsea_hallmarks_results_core %>% select(pathogen, timepoint, process, group),
             by = join_by("pathogen", "timepoint", "process")) %>% 
  filter(status == "Shared") %>% 
  inner_join(mean_percentage_shared %>% 
               filter(status == "Shared"), by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint, status)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
          timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus"), 
                                 paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                                 paste0("Day ", timepoint)),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, parse_number(timepoint)),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>% 
  mutate(process = fct_reorder(process, percent),
         facet_label = paste0(timepoint, ",\n Mean Shared = ", round(mean_perc, 1), "%")) %>% 
  arrange(-n, -percent)
```

Do these leading edges have the same log2fc?

```{r}
#Do these leading edges have the same log2fc?
df_test =
  dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(str_detect(process, "INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE")) %>% 
  
  # Join com os genes core
  full_join(
    gsea_hallmarks_results_core_joined %>% 
      filter(str_detect(process, "INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE")),
    by = join_by("pathogen", "process", "timepoint", symbol == gene)
  ) %>% 
  
  # join com shared %
  inner_join(
    shared_perc %>% 
      filter(str_detect(process, "INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE"),
             status == "Shared") %>%
      rename(percent = percent,
             status_percent = status),
    by = join_by("pathogen", "process", "timepoint")
  ) %>%
  
  # join com NES
  inner_join(
    dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      filter(str_detect(process, "INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE")) %>% 
      select(process, pathogen, timepoint, nes_Mouse, nes_Human),
    by = join_by("pathogen", "process", "timepoint")
  ) %>% 
  
  mutate(
    nes_Mouse = round(nes_Mouse, 2),
    nes_Human = round(nes_Human, 2)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(status = if_else(is.na(status), "Not core", status)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
          timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus"), 
                                 paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                                 paste0("Day ", timepoint)),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, parse_number(timepoint)),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Saureus", "Ecoli")) %>% 
  inner_join(dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation %>% 
               select(timepoint, pathogen, process, cor_value, r_squared, p_label, cor_label, cor_label_spearman),
             by = join_by("pathogen", "process", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(# criar label completo para facet
    facet_label = paste0(timepoint, ",\nShared = ", percent, "%,\n",
      "NES Mouse = ", nes_Mouse, ",\nNES Human = ", nes_Human
    ),
  facet_label = fct_reorder(facet_label, parse_number(as.character(timepoint))))
```

```{r}
#Import results -------

filename = "all_human_mouse"
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----


# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method =  "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    filter = "all",
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      p_label
    )
  )

cor_labels_filter_Mouse <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_mean_Mouse <= 0.25) %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,

  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_mouse = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value_mouse   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%

    r_squared_mouse = cor_value_mouse^2,
```

```{r fig.height=9, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_plot =

                    strip = strip_nested(size = "variable")) +

#Plot all points
```

## ORA of best and worst quartiles

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
# Enrichment analysis -------
organism = "org.Hs.eg.db"
#Hallmarks
#Retrieve human H (hallmark) gene set
msigdbr_raw <- msigdbr(species = "human", category = "H") 
#Clean
msigdbr_df = msigdbr_raw %>% 
  select(process = gs_name, genes = gene_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(process = str_remove(process, "HALLMARK_"))

#Discretize by quartile
df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse = zscore_genes %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_grouped = case_when(
    quartile_label %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<Q25",
    quartile_label %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">Q75",
    TRUE ~ quartile_label)) %>% 
    mutate(condition = paste0(comparison, "", quartiles_grouped, " (", timepoint_day,")")) %>% 
  filter(quartiles_grouped != "Q50") %>% 
  select(genes = human_symbol,
         condition)

#Run ORA Hallmarks
ora_all_diff_hallmark <- enricher_condition(
  df = df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse,
  term2gene_df = msigdbr_df) %>% 
  mutate(log_p_adjust = -log(p_adjust)) %>% 
  mutate(description = str_replace_all(description, "_", " ")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "(?<=\\(Day )\\d+")) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = case_when(str_detect(condition, "FIT") ~ "FIT",
                                str_detect(condition, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse"))
#Save
ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "ora_all_diff_hallmark.rds"))

#Print
ora_all_diff_hallmark
```


```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
##### Plot ORA Hallmark ------
#Import
ora_all_diff_hallmark = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ora_all_diff_hallmark.rds"))
#Cluster rows
row_clustered = ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
    dplyr::select(condition, description, log_p_adjust) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
                values_from= "log_p_adjust") %>%
    column_to_rownames("description") %>% 
    as.matrix() %>% 
    replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
    dist(.) %>% 
    hclust()

#Plot
ora_all_diff_hallmark_heatmap = ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(description %in% c(row_clustered$labels)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(condition, description, log_p_adjust, p_adjust, everything()) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ ""),
           quantile = str_extract(condition, "Q\\d{2,3}"),
        condition = paste(quantile)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=condition, y = str_to_upper(description), fill = log_p_adjust)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", 
            size = 0.2, na.rm = F, stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "white",     
        high = "#4DBBD5FF",   
        n.breaks = 3,
        oob = scales::squish,
        limits = c(0, 4),      # fixa o intervalo
        name = "-Log(FDR)") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.key.width = unit(0.2, 'cm'),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
          axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 1, hjust=0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
          strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white"),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 1, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "top") +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
     labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "ORA, MSigDB Hallmarks") +
  facet_nested(~ paste("Day", timepoint) + fct_rev(comparison), scales = "free", space = "free")
```

#### Top best and worst

```{r}
#Import data
pairwise_human_fit_measures = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_fit_dge_pairwise2human.rds")) 
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))
# Top best and worst predicted genes in FIT and Mouse -----
pairwise_human_fit_genes_long =  pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_human, mean_mouse, mean_fit),
               values_to = "l2fc",
               names_to = "organism") %>% 
  rename(diff_h2m = human_2_mouse,
         diff_h2fit = human_2_fit) %>% 
  mutate(organism = if_else(organism == "FIT Prediction", "FIT", organism)) %>% 
  
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(symbol, timepoint, organism),
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "metric") %>% 
  mutate(
    organism = case_when(
      str_detect(metric, "human") ~ "Human",
      str_detect(metric, "fit") ~ "FIT",
      str_detect(metric, "mouse") ~ "Mouse",
      metric == "Human" ~ "Human",
      metric == "FIT Prediction" ~ "FIT",
      TRUE ~ organism),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)$"),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(str_detect(metric, "h2m") ~ "Mouse",
                              str_detect(metric, "h2") ~ "FIT",
                              T~organism))  %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(organism == "mean_fit" ~ "FIT",
                              organism == "mean_human" ~ "Human",
                              organism == "mean_mouse" ~ "Mouse",
                              T ~ organism))

#Comparisons
pairwise_human_fit_measures_comparisons = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>%
    select(timepoint, symbol, human_2_mouse:effect_size_h2m) 

#Pivot table and join the comparisons
pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide = pairwise_human_fit_genes_long %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "metric",
              values_from = "value", 
              values_fn = mean) %>% 
  select(!c(pval:effect_size_h2m)) %>% 
  inner_join(pairwise_human_fit_measures_comparisons,
                by = join_by("timepoint", "symbol")) 


#Get top genes in each model
top_genes_human = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  relocate(ci_width,  .after = organism) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(ci_width) 
  
 top_genes_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse",
         symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$symbol)) %>% 
   arrange(ci_width, desc(p_value_h2m_adj), human_2_mouse)
 
 top_genes_fit = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "FIT",
         symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$symbol)) %>% 
   arrange(ci_width, desc(p_value_h2fit_adj), human_2_fit)
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  inner_join(worst_mouse_fit %>% 
              select(symbol, timepoint) %>%
               group_by(timepoint) %>% 
              mutate(day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
              distinct() %>% 
              slice_head(n = 5),
            by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint,
      y = l2fc,
      color = organism,
      fill = organism) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray75", alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = organism), position = position_dodge2(1)) +
  # facet_wrap(~day~human_symbol, nrow = 3, scales = "free") +
  facet_grid(~day~symbol, scales = "free") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, 
                  ymax = ci_high),
                position =  position_dodge(1)
                ) +
      geom_point( position = position_dodge(1),
             color = "black",
             pch = 21) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 3, 7),minor_breaks = F) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
  values = c(
    "FIT" = "#4361ee", 
    "Mouse" = "#546E7AFF",
    "Human" = "#4DBBD5FF"))+
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "FIT" = "#4361ee", 
    "Mouse" = "#546E7AFF",
    "Human" = "#4DBBD5FF"))+
    theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", angle = 0),
        strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(color = "Organism",
       x = "",
       y = "LogFold-Change",
       title = "Genes that were most different in Mouse prediction from FIT and human. Difference in Z-score")


worst_mouse_fit_plot
```

##### Get ranks

```{r}
#Get ranks -----
#Mouse
ranks_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, z_score_h2m, organism) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, abs(z_score_h2m)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2m)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(zscore_h2model = z_score_h2m)
#FIT
ranks_fit = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>%
  filter(organism == "FIT") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, z_score_h2fit, organism) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2fit)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(zscore_h2model = z_score_h2fit)

#Fit vs Mouse
ranks_fit_vs_mouse = ranks_fit %>% 
  select(symbol, fit = percentile, timepoint_ref = timepoint, zscore_h2fit = zscore_h2model) %>% 
  inner_join(ranks_mouse %>% 
               select(symbol, mouse = percentile,
                      timepoint_other = timepoint,
                      zscore_h2mouse = zscore_h2model),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_ref = as.character(timepoint_ref),
         timepoint_other = as.character(timepoint_other),
         condition = "Top FIT vs Mouse")

#Mouse vs FIT
ranks_mouse_vs_fit = ranks_mouse %>% 
  select(symbol, mouse = percentile, timepoint_ref = timepoint, zscore_h2mouse = zscore_h2model) %>% 
  inner_join(ranks_fit %>% 
               select(symbol, fit = percentile,
                      timepoint_other = timepoint,
                      zscore_h2fit = zscore_h2model),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_ref = as.character(timepoint_ref),
         timepoint_other = as.character(timepoint_other),
         condition = "Top Mouse vs FIT")


#Get genes that are in the 10th percentile in one model, but are in the 90th percentile in the other
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse = ranks_fit_vs_mouse %>%
  filter(fit < 10, mouse > 90) %>%
  bind_rows(ranks_mouse_vs_fit %>%
              filter(mouse < 10, fit > 90)) %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol,
         timepoint_ref,
         timepoint_other, 
         fit, zscore_h2fit,
         mouse, zscore_h2mouse)

ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long <- ranks_best_fit_and_mouse %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit, mouse),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "percentile"
  )


#Get genes with least zscores in one model, but have the highest zscore in the other
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_zscore = ranks_fit_vs_mouse %>%

  # FILTER BY N
  filter(timepoint_ref == timepoint_other) %>%
  arrange(abs(zscore_h2fit), desc(abs(zscore_h2mouse))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>% 
  bind_rows(ranks_mouse_vs_fit %>%
              filter(timepoint_ref == timepoint_other) %>%
  arrange(abs(zscore_h2mouse), desc(abs(zscore_h2fit))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)) %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol,
         timepoint_ref,
         timepoint_other, 
         fit = zscore_h2fit,
         mouse = zscore_h2mouse)
#Pivot longer
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long_zscore <- ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_zscore %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit, mouse),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "zscore"
  )

#Print
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long_zscore
```

Get best 10 and worst 90

```{r}
#Plot heatmap -----
#Get best 10 and worst 90
#Mouse
mouse_best_10 = best_mouse %>%
  inner_join(pairwise_genes_wide_mouse_fit %>% 
               select(timepoint:l2fc) %>% 
               filter(organism == "Mouse"),
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  # filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  select(symbol, z_score_h2m, l2fc, timepoint, organism) %>%
  group_by(organism, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(abs(z_score_h2m)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2m)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>%
  filter(percentile <= 10) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste("Mouse Best Day", timepoint))

mouse_worst_90 = best_mouse %>%
  inner_join(pairwise_genes_wide_mouse_fit %>% 
               select(timepoint:l2fc) %>% 
               filter(organism == "Mouse"),
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  select(symbol, z_score_h2m, l2fc, timepoint, organism) %>%
    group_by(organism, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(abs(z_score_h2m)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2m)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>%
  filter(percentile >= 90) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste("Mouse Worst Day", timepoint))

#FIT
fit_best_10 = best_fit %>%
  inner_join(pairwise_genes_wide_mouse_fit %>% 
               select(timepoint:l2fc) %>% 
               filter(organism == "FIT"),
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  select(symbol, z_score_h2fit, l2fc, timepoint, organism) %>%
  group_by(organism, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2fit)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>%
  filter(percentile <= 10) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste("FIT Best Day", timepoint))

fit_worst_90 = best_fit %>%
  inner_join(pairwise_genes_wide_mouse_fit %>% 
               select(timepoint:l2fc) %>% 
               filter(organism == "FIT"),
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  select(symbol, z_score_h2fit, l2fc, timepoint, organism) %>%
   group_by(organism, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2fit)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>%
  filter(percentile >= 90) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste("FIT Worst Day", timepoint))

#Bind tables
mouse_fit_best_worst = bind_rows(mouse_best_10, 
                                 fit_best_10,
                                 mouse_worst_90, 
                                 fit_worst_90) 

#Get overlaps
overlap_best_worst = mouse_fit_best_worst %>%
  select(symbol, l2fc, condition, organism, timepoint)  %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
          strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white", size = 10, 
                                      margin = margin(0.2,1,0.2,1, "cm")),
          panel.grid = element_blank(), 
          panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 1, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "bottom") +
     labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "ORA, Best and Worst genes, Percentile") +
  facet_nested(~ timepoint + best_worst, scales = "free", space = "free")


df_ora_mouse_fit_best_worst_perc_hallmark_heatmap

df_ora_mouse_fit_best_worst_perc_hallmark_heatmap %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "influenza_fluad_mouse_fit_prediction_ora_hallmark_bet_worst_percentile_heatmap_2.png"),
         width = 6,
```
